notes.content:

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[h3]Alright, ladies and gentlemen. The time has come! 
The fixed localization of Summer Crush is now available! [/h3]

[b]But other than that... This week's update features various quality-of-life improvements, including:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game size reduced from 8 GB to 1.5 GB ːtoolidlː
[*] Added Steam Cloud Saves! Now you can delete the game and not worry about your saves! 
[*] [b]LEGENDARY[/b] "Auto" button is now in the game! Lean back in your comfy chair and enjoy the show!
[*] Added one new achievement that you asked for so much!
[/list]
Now playable! Thank you for your patience! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43017617/95aaffe39f38a18c2d3c7050a37fe06e1c342637.png[/img]

By the way, join our [url=https://discord.gg/hFExfcp6rB]Discord server[/url] for weekly updates on new episodes!

notes.title: Today Is the Day!
notes.content:
November 25 is the 329th day in the Gregorian calendar. On this day, Albert Einstein presented the field equations of general relativity to the Prussian Academy of Sciences, the "Hollywood Ten" were blacklisted during the Red Scare, and Lee Harvey Oswalks was buried in Fort Worth, Texas. Famous birthdays include John F. Kennedy Jr., Christina Applegate, and Andrew Carnegie. November 25 also marks International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women.

And also...

[h1]Summer Crush is finally out![/h1]

There are a bunch of girls in one unnamed town who don't mind getting to know you better at all! Which one will you choose?

For contact and bug reports: 
[b]Email:[/b] wetnjuicygames@gmail.com
[b]Discord server:[/b] https://discord.gg/hFExfcp6rB

Enjoy the game!
